h1: Custom Foamworx Photo Frames for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Foamworx Photo Frames | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom Foamworx photo frames in bulk. Perfect for employee awards and event giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Foamworx photo frames offer a lightweight, durable alternative to traditional glass frames, making them ideal for bulk corporate orders. The foam core construction resists breakage during shipping, while the sleek mounting options—like the 4" x 6" Photo Mount or the unique Sunglasses Photo Frame—allow you to showcase branded images at trade shows or in office lobbies. Choose from standard sizes or specialty shapes to match your promotional needs.
heroAltText: Custom Foamworx photo frames in various sizes including 4x6 and 5x7 mounts for corporate branding
